cells.gaps: No law is enacted, so regulations and application are not held. MOZ-015 (April 2026) says the bill was already submitted to the Assembly while MOZ-005 and MOZ-006 (July and August 2026) describe it as still being prepared for submission; MOZ-001 (1 October 2026) places it on the Assembly's agenda. MOZ-013 (October 2025) says the Data Protection Office is not established, so authority stands at none.
cells.note: The bill is before the Assembly of the Republic, on its October 2026 agenda, but nothing is enacted, so the country is at stage 2, not 3. The government's approval and submission of the bill inside the twelve months is the advancing event.
